name: com.barliesque.event-objects
description: Create ScriptableObjects to serve as a conduit for generic, decoupled events.  Four unique types of events are supported:  Messenger (one-to-many), PartyLine (many-to-many), Mailbox (many-to-one), and Gauge (persistent global value).  The ability to reference Event Objects by dragging and dropping them into the Inspector makes them very easy to implement.
